Definition: from G2513; to cleanse, i.e. (specially) to prune; figuratively, to expiate:--purge.
BiblicalUsage: Every branch in Me that beareth not fruit He taketh away, and every branch that beareth fruit He purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the pruning hurts, but the branch that is pruned bears more, and the Gardener knows what He is doing.
